text:
Version 2.4 is out.

We fixed 12 crashes, so the app should stop quitting on you unexpectedly.

The app also starts faster. Startup used to take 3.4 seconds and now takes 1.9.

The biggest addition is Offline Mode. You can keep working in the app when your connection drops.

Version 2.4 no longer supports Android 8. Dropping it lets us put more time into features and performance work for newer devices. If you're still on Android 8, you'll need a newer version to get this update.

Thanks for using the app. You can update now.
